SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

s.h: WELDING AUTOMATION ENGINEER, CHAMBER AND NOZZLE (RAPTOR)
s.t:
SpaceX is seeking an engineer with deep expertise in automated welding to create the Raptor engine’s combustion chamber and nozzle. These components feature some of the most complex geometries in rocket propulsion — including intricate regenerative cooling channels, thin-walled high-temperature alloys, and tight-tolerance surfaces that must survive extreme thermal and pressure cycles across hundreds of reuse cycles.
You will design, implement, and scale manual and automated welding systems that increase production throughput, improve weld consistency, and reduce defects while enabling rapid design iteration. This role sits at the intersection of propulsion engineering, weld engineering, with aspects of real-time process control, and data-driven quality systems.
Your work will directly enable rapid iteration and high-volume production of Raptor chambers and nozzles.

Develop, deploy and iteratively improve automated welding systems for Raptor combustion chambers and nozzles, including manual and automated arc and beam welding processes
Design and optimize automated weld paths, parameters, and sequences for complex geometries in regenerative cooling channels and nozzle structures
Implement weld process control with real-time monitoring of arc characteristics, temperature, seam tracking, and penetration using advanced sensors
Build and maintain data pipelines that capture manufacturing telemetry to enable statistical process control, predictive analytics, and machine learning models for defect reduction and process optimization
Develop fixture and material handling solutions that support high-precision welding in a wide variety of forms and materials
Drive continuous improvement of welding automation through scripting (Python), PLC logic, and advanced process modeling to reduce cycle time and scrap rates
Partner closely with propulsion design, materials, production, and supply chain teams to convert new designs into robust, scalable processes, resolve nonconformances, and drive design changes that improve manufacturability, reliability, and performance

Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline.
1+ years of experience with welding processes for complex metallic components

Strong programming skills in Python and experience with industrial automation (robotic welding systems, PLCs, or real-time controllers)
Demonstrated success deploying robotic welding, laser welding, or vision-guided welding systems in production environments
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment with aggressive schedules
Ability to work well in an integrated and collaborative team environment including daily interactions with technicians, engineers, and managers
Direct experience welding rocket engine chambers, nozzles, or regeneratively cooled hardware
Expertise in welding of high-performance alloys (nickel and copper alloys, stainless steels) using GTAW, laser, or plasma processes
Background in real-time weld monitoring, adaptive control, and closed-loop feedback systems
Experience with offline robot programming, weld simulation software, and integrating welding cells into larger manufacturing lines
Familiarity with non-destructive evaluation tied to welding (ultrasonic, X-ray, CT, or thermography)
Knowledge of statistical process control, GD&T, and data-driven methods for weld quality prediction
Highly self-motivated with strong organizational and written/oral communication skills – able to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment with the ongoing drive for continuous improvement in all aspects of work

Must be comfortable stooping, bending, and standing.

Instrument hardware using accelerometers, strain gauges, force sensors, displacement sensors, and other dynamic measurement systems.

Develop comprehensive test plans, procedures, reports, and technical presentations that clearly communicate results and engineering recommendations.

Senior Quality Engineer
About LawnStarter
LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $100M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services, operating across three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome) on a single shared platform.
About Engineering at LawnStarter
We've spent the last two years rebuilding the platform from the ground up: new customer app, new Pro onboarding, job distribution engine, and data infrastructure. The foundation is solid. Now we're moving into expanded service verticals, dynamic pricing, and AI-powered features at scale. Quality needs to keep up.
Our stack is PHP (Laravel) and React/React Native, with Cypress as our primary test framework. We actively use Claude Code as part of our engineering workflow, not as an experiment, but as a core part of how we work.

As we scale into new service verticals and grow the engineering team, quality can't be reactive. This role exists to make quality proactive: owning the automation coverage, shaping the bug process, and partnering closely with Product, Design, and the Data team to catch problems before they reach customers.
You'll report to the Engineering Manager and be embedded across the engineering organization. This is hands-on and strategic, helping raise the quality ceiling for the whole team.

Cross-functional influence : You work directly with engineers, PMs, Designers, and the Data team to surface risks early, understand requirements deeply, and propose better solutions. You may be embedded in one or two delivery teams.
Automation ownership : You own the strategy for building and expanding our automated test coverage, not just executing test cases someone else wrote.
Process shaper : You'll identify gaps in our quality process and have the authority to fix them, not just flag them.
What You'll Own
Automated test coverage : Design and grow our E2E and integration test suite using Cypress. Set the strategy, prioritize coverage gaps, and raise the floor across the platform.
Bug process : Own the full lifecycle from triage to production fix. Keep it moving, keep stakeholders informed, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
Cross-functional quality partnership : Collaborate with PMs, Designers, and the Data team to review requirements, raise risks early, and define what "done" actually means.
Process improvement : Identify weaknesses in how we deliver software and propose solutions. Not just document them.
Exploratory testing : Test new features and existing flows on web and mobile across devices, catching what automation misses.
Problems to Solve
Keeping automation coverage sharp as the product evolves Our E2E coverage is solid. The challenge is staying ahead: bringing new ideas, exploring different types of coverage, and finding smarter ways to automate different aspects of the application as the product grows and new service verticals come online.
Exploring new tools and leveraging AI to improve quality operations AI is changing how we build software, and it's changing how we can test it too. There's real opportunity here to use AI tools to increase output quality, cut repetitive work, and discover coverage gaps we'd otherwise miss. We want someone who actively explores that space, not someone who waits to be told what to use.
What Success Looks Like (Year 1)
Automation coverage stays strong : New features ship with automated tests as a baseline, and coverage strategies evolve with the product.
Bug process runs smoothly : Triage to fix cycle is predictable and stakeholders know where things stand without having to ask.
Deep business knowledge : You understand how the marketplace works well enough to anticipate edge cases on your own.
Quality process improvement shipped : At least one meaningful improvement to how we deliver quality is in place and being used by the team.

AI-native. You use AI tools like Claude Code to write, maintain, and extend test code, not as a novelty, but as a standard part of how you work. You're comfortable with browser MCPs, agent workflows, and building scripts that automate the boring parts of QA. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're skeptical of AI in the engineering workflow.
Automation-first. Your default when you find a problem is to ask how to prevent it automatically. You build test infrastructure that outlasts any individual test case. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your strength is manual testing and automation is something you tolerate rather than drive.
Customer-obsessed. You think like a user. When you're testing a flow, you're asking whether it actually works for a real customer, not just whether it matches the spec. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you treat quality as a checkbox rather than a standard.
Adaptable. You don't get attached to a single tool, stack, or process. We're in a period of rapid evolution in how software gets built and tested, especially with AI, and you lean into that rather than resist it. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you thrive only in stable, well-defined tooling environments.
Collaborative and direct. You work across Product, Design, Engineering, and Operations. You surface risks early, speak plainly about what you find, and push back when something isn't ready to ship. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you prefer to work in isolation or soften feedback to avoid friction.
Technically solid. You're comfortable reading and writing code. You understand front and backend web services well enough to test them properly, write meaningful SQL queries, and debug issues across the stack. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your technical depth is limited to a single layer or framework.
This Role Is NOT
A manual-testing role : Most of your testing work should be building automation, not executing test scripts by hand.
A ticket-executor role : You're expected to shape what gets worked on and how, not just process a backlog.
A single-tool role : We use Cypress today, but we adapt. If you're only comfortable in one framework or one part of the stack, this will be limiting.
A role for someone who avoids ambiguity : The business is changing fast. New verticals, new flows, new edge cases. You need to be comfortable moving before everything is defined.
A back-of-the-line role : Quality is a first-class concern here. You're expected to have opinions and influence the process upstream, not just verify what's already been built.

Equity: We want you invested in the quality and long-term health of the platform you're helping build.
Fully remote: Work from anywhere in the Americas. Deep focus and async collaboration are the norm here.
Unlimited PTO: We focus on results. Take what you need.

Why Scout24?
Scout24 is home of ImmoScout24, Germany’s #1 for real estate. With ImmoScout24 we have been revolutionizing the real estate market in Germany and Austria for more than 25 years. Our goal is to build a digital ecosystem that brings homeowners, seekers, and agents together.

Finding the right home and property is one of the most important decisions in life. So is your career! #WorkingatScout24 means being part of a diverse and inclusive team of around 1100 colleagues and 58 nationalities. We embrace difference and celebrate individuality.

By encouraging open mindedness and authenticity we enable a true learning culture and prepare the ground for personal development. Mistakes are a chance to grow and to innovate. Together we act proactively, strive for improvement, and take responsibility.

We talk about success and challenge while treating each other with respect because we are #oneteam .
If this sounds interesting to you, we would love to see you joining us! Even if you may not tick all the boxes of the job requirements, we are happy to hear about the value you can add to the team. Grow with us!. Welcome home!
Aside from our people and company culture we are offering awesome benefits that make Scout24 a great place to work!

s.h: Compensation: A competitive salary package and a bonus on top.
s.t:
Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work model with three days of on-site work per week in the office, and you can organize the remaining days as you wish. We offer you 30 days of vacation per year.
Work from abroad: We offer you the possibility to work from abroad for 10 days per year, subject to the business requirements of the company and team.
Relocation: Our relocation agency supports you with your visa process and an attractive relocation package.
Use our products: As an employee you can take advantage of our plus membership for tenants on ImmoScout24 to find a new place to live.
Development: Dedicated learning time per month, online courses on our ScoutAcademy, regular book challenges, structured feedback, “Lunch & Learn”-Events and individual career paths to push your career to the next level.
Have kids? We'll support you with a professional family service, which helps you to find a childcare center or offers emergency childcare.
Furry feel good manager : Bring your dog to work (upon approval, as we prioritise the well-being of our employees and ensure that our dog policy is considerate of allergic individuals and prevents overcrowding on each office floor).
Mobility: We subsidize public transport or Job Bikes.
Commitment to sustainability and Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) : We have clear environmental and climate protection goals and are involved in social activities and charitable organizations throughout the year. We live the diversity. Our theme weeks on diversity, mental well-being, and other social issues give us time and space to develop ourselves on DEI and sustainability.
Pension scheme : We offer a company pension scheme and support your own contribution with an attractive subsidy.
Most innovative office: Our office is barrier-free and in the heart of Berlin right at the central station. It was awarded for the most innovative office concept. We have an own gym with regular courses, napping room, rooftop terrace, organic coffee, cafeteria, 100% green electricity and a massage therapist that comes in once a week.
Health: Life Situation Coaching, regular health check ups
We are a tech company: We work with the latest technical tools and hardware.
The Employee Experience Team is part of Scout24’s Tech organization. We improve the employee experience by turning operational needs into reliable, scalable digital services and automation. Working across People, Employee Technology, and other business and technical teams, we understand workflows, connect enterprise systems, improve service quality, and build reusable foundations for future use cases.
In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of AI-enabled employee services: from working with domain experts and shaping ambiguous problems to designing, building, evaluating, deploying, and continuously improving solutions in production. You will have the autonomy to make architectural decisions, establish reusable engineering patterns, and help shape how responsible AI automation is implemented across future use cases at Scout24.

s.h: How your role will look like
s.t:
Partner with business and technical teams to understand workflows, constraints, risks, failure modes, and desired outcomes before shaping solutions.
Own the technical direction, implementation, reliability, maintenance, and continuous evolution of AI-enabled employee services.
Design and build production-ready AI applications using suitable patterns such as retrieval, structured outputs, tool use, document processing, and multi-step workflows.
Define appropriate human-review and escalation points for sensitive, uncertain, exceptional, or policy-dependent decisions.
Integrate AI-enabled workflows with enterprise systems, APIs, data sources, and operational processes through reliable interfaces and secure data flows.
Establish evaluation approaches from the outset, including representative test cases, quality criteria, risk scenarios, release thresholds, and regression checks.
Build and operate the surrounding production software, including data models, background processing, automated testing, delivery pipelines, observability, and incident response.
Monitor quality, safety, latency, cost, adoption, and business outcomes, using production evidence to continuously improve the system and its underlying engineering patterns.

Senior-level software engineering experience, with strong system-design skills and experience delivering reliable, scalable applications in production.
Hands-on experience taking at least one AI-enabled application beyond the prototype stage into production, including implementation, evaluation, deployment, and operation.
Strong backend or full-stack engineering fundamentals, including APIs, data modelling, asynchronous processing, automated testing, debugging, delivery pipelines, observability, and maintainable code.
Practical experience with production LLM applications, including prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, and evaluation approaches.
Sound judgement in choosing when AI adds value and when deterministic software or human decision-making is more appropriate, reliable, or efficient.
Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, and collaborative working skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous needs and operational constraints into pragmatic technical solutions.
Working knowledge of privacy, security, access control, hallucination risk, latency, reliability, model selection, cost, tool-calling, and multi-step or agentic workflows; fluency in English.
Experience leveraging AI tools to drive problem-solving and productivity, maintaining effective human oversight and judgement.

Experience with multimodal AI or document-based workflows.
Familiarity with orchestration frameworks or comparable technologies for building and operating AI applications.

The Digital Sector under Military Services Solutions Business Area at Leidos currently has an opening for a Quality Assurance Engineer position which will be 100% remote. This is an exciting opportunity to use your experience helping with the [AGUN Program] mission.

The current customer Unified Network Modernization (UNM) is a critical mission provider of global network modernization projects.

The Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) - Increment 1 (INC1) contract will unify the next generation of Army transport to comply with the Joint Regional Security Stack (JRSS) divestiture mandate by designing, maintaining, rapidly deploying, and transitioning a globally orchestrated Software Defined Networking (SDN) solution.
The Quality Assurance Engineer serves as a key member of the AGUN Mission Assurance and Quality Engineering team, providing independent oversight of program execution, contractual compliance, operational performance, and continuous process improvement.

The position partners with Program Management, Engineering, Logistics, Configuration Management, Cybersecurity, and Customer stakeholders to ensure program execution is compliant, measurable, predictable, and continuously improving throughout the entire acquisition and deployment lifecycle.
The Quality Assurance Engineer serves as an independent quality authority supporting Mission Assurance activities through objective verification, deployment readiness assessments, quality gates, risk-based decision support, and continuous process improvement to ensure successful contract execution and customer mission outcomes.
Key Primary Responsibilities are broken into three (3) Quality Management Systems (QMS), Mission Assurance and Program Integration categories:
Quality Management and Integration
Support the Quality Manager in the execution of plans and activities that measure compliance with Leidos EngineeringEdge® NextGen policies and standards.
Integrate closely with program team members and leadership to continuously implement and improve the Quality Management System (QMS).
Support program Staff Meetings, governance activities, and reporting requirements.
Report on the status of program quality, compliance, performance, risks, and improvement initiatives to Program Leadership and Leidos Management.
Support other quality engineering and mission assurance activities across the program as required.
Mission Assurance and Governance
Support Mission Assurance activities by participating in quality review gates, deployment readiness reviews, operational readiness assessments, milestone decision reviews, and customer acceptance activities.
Participate in Engineering Review Boards (ERBs), Customer Working Level Integrated Product Team meetings (WIPTs), Programmatic Meetings, and Quality Management Reviews (QMRs) by providing independent quality assessments, objective evidence, and recommendations.
Verify objective evidence supporting milestone decisions, contractual compliance, deployment readiness, and customer acceptance criteria.
Monitor overall program health through quality metrics, audits, performance trends, and risk indicators to support informed management decision-making.
Risk Management and Continuous Improvement
Lead internal audits, compliance reviews, and performance evaluations to proactively identify systemic issues and ensure sustainable resolution and prevention of recurrence.
Drive portfolio-level risk management integration in coordination with Program Managers and Task Order leadership, ensuring consistent identification, documentation, mitigation, and trend analysis of quality, technical, operational, and programmatic risks.
Leverage enterprise tools and platforms (e.g., SharePoint, Configuration Management repositories, AI-enabled analytics, dashboards, and program governance systems) to enhance reporting transparency, operational visibility, and executive decision support.
Contribute to enterprise quality strategy, governance alignment, organizational maturity, and continuous improvement initiatives supporting long-term mission success.

Performance Monitoring & Compliance Assurance
Measure program performance against contractual requirements and ensure alignment with customer mission objectives.
Review deliverables and processes to ensure full lifecycle compliance with performance requirements, recording quality review results for traceability and analysis.
Verify end-to-end traceability of contractual requirements through planning, design, implementation, verification, deployment, and customer acceptance.
Conduct and support data management related to Service Level Agreements (SLAs); monitor internal Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for trends in QMS adherence.
Oversee SLA/KPI performance analytics, leveraging data-driven insights to anticipate risk, reduce performance variability, and strengthening contractual execution.
Develop executive dashboards and performance metrics to identify trends, support predictive quality analysis, and enable proactive decision-making.
Assist in the creation and execution of the Internal Audit Schedule for compliance with PWS, Leidos policies, ISO 9001:2015, and CMMI-Dev.
Plan, coordinate, and execute risk-based internal audits supporting contractual requirements, Leidos EngineeringEdge®, ISO 9001:2015, and CMMI-DEV compliance.
Ensure the Internal Quality Audit schedule is properly executed, identifying objective evidence and providing added value.
Maintain evidence and quality artifacts in SharePoint to support audit readiness for site installations and supply chain functions.
Defect, Nonconformance, and Root Cause Management
Identify and communicate deliverables or services (RIPs, TARs, EWWs) that fail to meet quality standards and track them in the quality system.
Log defects, observations, and risks identified during site visits using quality tracking tools; ensure mitigation and disposition before final sign-off.
Document and ensuring defective or noncompliant items found during inspections are tracked with supporting evidence [i.e., photos, defect log entries].
Communicate Opportunities for Improvement (OFIs) and Corrective Action Requests (CARs); manage and track resolution to closure.
Conduct thorough root cause analyses and recommend corrective and preventive actions; ensure issues are resolved and closed on schedule.
Process Improvements
Lead enterprise-wide process improvements and operational excellence initiatives to improve quality, efficiency, cost, schedule, and customer satisfaction.
Facilitate Lean Six Sigma Kaizen events, Value Stream Mapping, DMAIC initiatives, and business process reengineering activities to improve operational performance.
Analyze business processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, risks, and opportunities; design and implement future state solutions.
Lead cross functional teams in planning, facilitating, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Drive automation, workflow optimization, and digital transformation initiatives to improve business processes and operational performance.

We are seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer who combines strong manual testing skills with experience in test automation to help build quality into the software delivery process. This role is ideal for someone who believes quality is a shared team responsibility that starts when requirements are being written. They will contribute to building testing practices that ensure fast, reliable, and continuous delivery of high-quality software.
The right candidate will have a shift-left mindset, working closely with product managers, developers, and other QA engineers to identify risks early, improve test coverage, and embed quality into the entire SDLC.

Execute high-level manual exploratory testing for new features while simultaneously building out automated test scripts for long-term stability
Develop and maintain automated test suites using frameworks such as Playwright or Selenium
Participate actively in agile ceremonies providing the “QA voice” to keep the team focused on quality deliverables.
Collaborate with engineers and product managers to clarify acceptance criteria and testability
Perform exploratory testing to uncover edge cases and usability issues
Analyze test results, identify bugs, and work closely with developers for timely resolution.
Investigate defects, help isolate root causes, and work with engineering teams to ensure resolution
Advocate for shift-left testing practices and continuous improvement in quality processes.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
5+ years of experience in software quality assurance with a focus on automation
Experience performing both manual and automated testing
Proficiency with automation tools such as Playwright or Selenium
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Expertise with at least one programming/scripting language
Solid understanding of agile methodologies with a Shift-Left mindset.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills

Experience with BDD (Gherkin, Cucumber)
Familiarity with performance or integration testing
Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail)
Knowledge of API testing tools

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.
Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.
In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.
At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.
Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

Wayve's Verification and Release Test team sits at the intersection of Hardware, Embedded Software, and Machine Learning Models. Testing spans component, system, and vehicle levels, and we pride ourselves on finding the most efficient and effective ways to deliver the most valuable results for the company.
As a System Test Automation Engineer, you'll independently own the design and delivery of automated verification for a defined area of our embedded software stack. You'll build robust, reusable test automation, drive failures to root cause across engineering boundaries, and steadily raise the bar on coverage, reliability, and traceability.

This is a hands-on delivery role with room to grow into broader areas of the system including sensing and model-behaviour testing as the company and your experience evolve. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a sharp eye for improvement across multiple engineering domains.

Develop automation for system functionality tests at component, integration, and system levels, across software and hardware boundaries.
Automate open-loop and closed-loop replay based Tests, reliability and fault-injection tests to support verification, release, coverage expansion, and debug workflows.
Lead root-cause investigations for failures found during test campaigns, collaborating across hardware, software, and infrastructure teams.
Optimise buildkite CI/CD-integrated test workflows for rapid, reliable, and repeatable execution.
Integrate third-party verification tools including JAMA (requirements), MC/DC (coverage), and MISRA (style compliance); manage artefacts via Artifactory and Azure.
Define and track KPIs and quality metrics for system testing, supporting data-driven validation and release decisions.
Uncover software and hardware bugs through increased test coverage and report findings through JIRA.
Identify and implement infrastructure improvements that enhance test coverage, failure traceability, and compliance reporting.
Review, create, and adhere to Risk Assessments to ensure all testing activities are conducted safely and responsibly.
To set you up for success as a System Test Automation Engineer at Wayve, we're looking for the following skills and experience.

Hands-on experience with system-level verification and validation in robotics, embedded software, or mechatronic systems, with a track record of delivering test automation independently.
Experience with L2+ hands-off, L3, or L4 automated driving systems.
Knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols (e.g., Euro NCAP -AEB, LSS/LKA, ADAS scenarios), DCAS regulatory testing (UN R171), and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards (ISO/SAE 21434, UN R155).
Experience with HiL testing and tooling using CAN, Ethernet, GMSL, dSPACE, Vector, Xylon, or similar.
Strong proficiency in Python, including developing automation test frameworks with pytest.
Proven ability in interface-level testing, including hardware/software interactions and embedded interfaces.
Experience integrating software quality assurance tools and standards (ASPICE, SOTIF, ISO 26262, JAMA, X-RAY).
Knowledge of open- and closed-loop HiL replay using dSPACE or other emulators.
Proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling (e.g., GitLab CI, Buildkite, Bazel).
Experience with test automation dashboards, logging, and reporting infrastructure (e.g., Grafana, Looker, Datadog, JIRA).
Experience developing or testing automotive software across embedded and system levels.
Strong cross-functional communication skills; able to work collaboratively across software, hardware, autonomy, DevOps, and product teams.

Experience with autonomous vehicle systems, ADAS, or related technologies..
Strong Python Automation and knowledge of dSPACE open and closed Loop HIL based replay Testing
Experience contributing to continuous improvement of test methods, safety procedures, or operational efficiency.
Awareness of data management and version control systems (e.g., Git, Buildkite, or similar).
Familiarity with agentic AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) and a demonstrated ability to use them to accelerate and optimise test development, debugging, and automation workflows.

Forget boring manual testing! Join our Synera team on the mission to reach 100% automation, working across web and desktop environments with various tech stacks. 🚀

We're looking for a QA Engineer who's passionate about test automation and loves solving technical challenges across different tech stacks. At Synera , you'll work on a unique mix of web and desktop applications that connect AI, engineering tools, and complex user workflows – and you'll have the freedom with unlimited AI tokens to automate the boring stuff and focus on what matters.
You’ll join the Marketplace team, led by Andrew (VP of Software Partnerships), is formalizing in 2026 with dedicated full-time roles. You'll work alongside Hussein (add-in evangelism & learning content), Mark and Baha (add-in reviews), and Niklas and Andrey (partner onboarding & add-in development). The team's mission is to provide ready-made connections to all major engineering software for our customers.
As part of the QA team, you'll be the advocate for software quality. You'll work with developers to share testing knowledge, work together with solution engineers to solve customer problems, build automated tests for new features, or let AI build them for you, and help us scale quality as we scale our platform. This isn't about finding bugs – it's about preventing them and making our entire engineering process faster and more reliable.

🤖 Build & maintain automated test pipelines
You extend our Playwright end-to-end test suite, reduce manual regression testing time, and keep our CI/CD pipelines running smoothly. Your goal: automate the repetitive stuff so the team can ship faster with confidence. This also extends to AI-assisted development.
🤝 Collaborate closely with internal & external developers
You will be responsible for testing in- and externally developed add-ins for our software. These can include integrations into other applications like CAD or Simulation tools and you will be point of contact.
🔍 Investigate & solve complex issues
You dig into bug reports from users and support, reproduce tricky issues, and work with the team to understand root causes. You design test scenarios for both new and existing functionality across different platforms.
🚀 Ship quality with every commit
You work in a fast-paced environment where QA isn't a separate phase – it's integrated into the AI-assisted development process. You validate features, monitor pipelines, and ensure that quality is built in from day one.
🌱 Learn & share knowledge
You participate in team initiatives to explore new tools, test LLM-powered features, and experiment with innovative approaches to quality.

You become a reliable QA team member - testing changes to complete reviews and ensuring quality is built into every add-in release.
You’ve set up your first AI-first pipeline for testing updates to certain existing add-ins

You'll extend our automated end-to-end Playwright pipeline to include test cases currently done manually, integrating seamlessly into our sprint workflows.
You also take ownership of the marketplace add-in review pipeline - prioritizing new add-in reviews based on feedback from the Head of Marketplace, and ensuring bugs are tracked and reported back to partners in a timely manner.
You’ve set up AI-first pipelines for testing updates to most existing and some new add-ins.

Your AI automation work will reduce manual testing effort from 4 hours to 10 minutes, freeing the team to focus on innovation while maintaining high quality.
You can trace bugs back to the changes that caused them, helping us prevent similar issues in the future.

We are looking for a Senior Product Quality Engineer, EE to join our Product Quality team in San Francisco, California. In this role you will lead Early Field Failure Analysis (EFFA), field quality, and product safety for the Oura Ring, covering both products currently in mass production and earlier generations still in members’ hands.

You will determine why electrical failures occur in the field, confirm the mechanism behind them, and drive the design, process, supplier, and test changes required to prevent them from recurring.
Job responsibilities include leading electrical failure analysis on returned units, building serial-level evidence packages from manufacturing, test, and telemetry data, and establishing commonality across build, supplier, revision, and geography. You will define containment and escalation for field safety issues, direct corrective action with our contract manufacturers (CMs) and suppliers, and verify effectiveness against field and factory data before an action is considered closed.
A core objective of this role is closing the quality loop. You will convert confirmed field and factory findings into design, DFMEA, test coverage, and component selection inputs for NPI programs, so that mechanisms identified on shipping products are designed out of the next generation. This requires close partnership with Electrical Engineering, Firmware, Reliability, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, Data, and Member Experience.
This role spans the bench, the data, and the factory floor. Strong electrical engineering fundamentals, hands-on failure analysis capability, and practical data analysis skill are all essential for success in this role.
This is a US Hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with an in-office requirement of three days per week.

Own electrical Early Field Failure Analysis (EFFA) for Oura Ring products, from returned unit intake and evidence review through technical disposition, confirmed mechanism, and closure
Lead field quality and safety investigations for battery, charging, and power-related issues, including risk assessment, containment and escalation decisions, and the supporting technical rationale for Reliability, Regulatory, and Member Experience
Direct non-destructive-first analysis workflows covering received-condition documentation, electrical characterization, ring diagnostics, optical inspection, and imaging prior to any destructive analysis
Isolate failure mechanisms across power, battery, charging, sensor, clock, connectivity, interconnect, and leakage-related faults to the component, material, or process level using DMM, oscilloscope, current measurement, thermal imaging, micro-probing, and X-ray/CT
Build serial-level evidence packages combining product configuration, hardware and firmware revision, manufacturing genealogy, factory test history, telemetry, and diagnostic records against the member-reported symptom
Analyze field, factory, and FA data to establish commonality across manufacturing site, build lot, supplier, component, ring size, hardware and firmware revision, product age, geography, and diagnostic signature
Distinguish reported symptom from failed function and confirmed mechanism, documenting supporting and contradicting evidence, remaining open questions, and confidence in the disposition
Drive corrective action with CMs and suppliers, including factory containment, process control updates, inspection and test coverage, design and firmware changes, and additional reliability validation
Verify corrective action effectiveness against before-and-after field, factory, reliability, or component data prior to closure
Feed confirmed field and factory findings into NPI through design and DFMEA reviews, component and supplier selection, test coverage definition, traceability requirements, and reliability planning
Partner with Data and Software teams on data ingestion, SQL and Python analysis, dashboards, and triage logic to convert confirmed mechanisms into leading indicators and proactive capture criteria
Establish FA methods, standard operating procedures, equipment requirements, and reporting templates, and build repeatable capability across Oura’s regional labs and CM partners
Present findings to engineering and quality leadership, clearly separating observation, hypothesis, confirmed mechanism, corrective action, and open risk
You are a technical leader who insists on evidence and is comfortable with ambiguity. You understand that a passing functional test is not the same as a robust product, and that the purpose of failure analysis is not to explain a single return but to prevent the same mechanism from reaching future members.

Our platform handles real, live conversations — and because those conversations matter, quality is critical. Small errors have real consequences. We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and grow the automated testing that keeps our voice AI platform reliable.
You will build and maintain automated test coverage across backend and frontend, create automation that places and validates real test calls end to end, and measure the accuracy of the speech-to-text (STT) and text-to-speech (TTS) layers that make the platform work. Job Description
Job Title : Software Design Assurance Quality Engineer

· Facilitates the development, maintenance, and management of comprehensive software quality documentation, including Software Requirement Specifications (SRS), ensuring they are accurate, up-to-date, and fully compliant with relevant standards and regulatory requirements throughout the software lifecycle, working under limited supervision.

· Leads the assessment of software designs, including reviewing test and performance data, to ensure they meet quality, safety, and regulatory standards, while identifying and addressing quality engineering deficiencies to embed quality within the design.

· Conducts in-depth root cause analysis for software quality issues, employing problem-solving techniques to resolve deficiencies and improve software design processes, ensuring that quality is integral to the development process.

· Validates key software design inputs such as usability, reliability, performance, localizability, safety, privacy, and cost to ensure they meet customer and regulatory requirements, supporting the delivery of high-quality software products.

· Provides effective oversight of the execution of software quality plans and associated risk management activities throughout the software lifecycle, ensuring that all design-related activities are managed according to defined processes.

· Utilizes post-market analytics and statistics to monitor software performance in the field, providing feedback to manufacturing, suppliers, and design teams, while initiating corrective actions or field actions when required to maintain software quality.

· Ensures the development of comprehensive Software Quality Plans that cover all stages of the software lifecycle, from design through to post-market, supporting the design of these plans and ensuring adherence to quality and regulatory standards.

· Possesses and applies working knowledge of relevant global regulations, requirements, and standards, ensuring that all quality activities and software design processes comply with applicable regulatory requirements, facilitating compliance throughout the software development lifecycle.

· Acts as a subject matter expert, providing guidance to meet schedules, resolve technical problems, and manage performance requirements, including mentoring on quality engineering practices, regulatory compliance, and QMS processes.

· Monitors, and reports on key software quality metrics, ensuring these metrics are aligned with business objectives and regulatory expectations, while communicating quality-related performance indicators to relevant stakeholders.

· Helps to identify opportunities for process improvements within software quality engineering, advocating for and implementing best practices, tools, and innovative methodologies to enhance software quality and regulatory compliance.

s.h: ABOUT US METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability
s.t:
We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.
And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.
Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.
READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.
The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.
We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.
Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.
YOUR MISSION PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary
YOUR PROFILE 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen
WHY JOIN US? You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact
You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage

Rejoignez un acteur clé de la micro\-fabrication médicale
Chez Resonetics, nous repoussons les limites de la micro\-fabrication au service des dispositifs médicaux et du diagnostic. Nos technologies de pointe permettent à nos clients d’innover et d’améliorer la vie des patients à travers le monde.
Notre site de Puidoux, qui compte 150 collaborateurs, est un fournisseur stratégique de tubes métalliques et composants de haute précision destinés aux appareils médicaux. Dans un contexte de croissance et d’exigence réglementaire forte, nous renforçons notre équipe qualité.
Nous recherchons un Quality Engineer expérimenté, prêt à jouer un rôle central dans la performance qualité de notre site.
Votre mission
En tant que Quality Engineer, vous jouez un rôle clé dans le maintien et l’amélioration de notre Système de Management de la Qualité et accompagnez les équipes opérationnelles dans la maîtrise de nos produits et procédés.
Véritable partenaire de la Production, du contrôle qualité, de l’Engineering/NPI ainsi que de nos clients et fournisseurs, vous intervenez au plus près des opérations pour prévenir les risques, résoudre les problématiques qualité et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de nos performances.
Vous évoluez dans un environnement technique, international et fortement réglementé, où votre expertise contribue directement à la fiabilité de composants destinés à des dispositifs médicaux innovants.
Vos responsabilités
🔹 Système de Management de la Qualité
Contribuer au maintien et à l’amélioration continue du Système de Management de la Qualité (SMQ) conformément aux exigences applicables, notamment ISO 13485
Rédiger, réviser et maintenir les procédures, instructions et enregistrements qualité
Participer à la formation initiale et continue des collaborateurs aux exigences du SMQ
Planifier et conduire des audits internes et assurer le suivi des plans d’actions associés
Participer à la préparation et au suivi des audits clients et audits de certification
Contribuer à la veille normative et réglementaire applicable au site
🔹 Qualité opérationnelle \& résolution de problèmes

Définir, mettre en œuvre et suivre les actions correctives et préventives (CAPA) et vérifier leur efficacité
Participer au traitement des réclamations clients, conduire les investigations associées et contribuer à la préparation des réponses clients
Être le référent Qualité lors des réunions quotidiennes Tier 2, en collaboration avec les équipes Production, NPI et Engineering, afin d’identifier, prioriser et résoudre les problématiques opérationnelles et qualité
Apporter un support qualité quotidien aux équipes de Production, QC et Engineering/NPI
Participer à la définition, au développement et à l’amélioration des plans de contrôle
Contribuer aux analyses de risques produits et procédés (FMEA / AMDEC)
Utiliser les outils statistiques appropriés pour analyser et améliorer la performance des procédés : SPC, MSA, Gage R\&R, études de capabilité Cp/Cpk, analyses de tendances, etc.
Participer aux initiatives Lean, de réduction des non\-conformités et d’amélioration continue

Évaluer l’impact qualité des modifications de produits, procédés, équipements ou méthodes dans le cadre du Change Control
Contribuer à garantir la maîtrise et la robustesse des procédés de fabrication
🔹 Interface clients \& fournisseurs

Participer aux échanges techniques et qualité avec les clients ainsi qu’aux revues des exigences applicables
Contribuer à l’évaluation des demandes de modification et des exigences qualité spécifiques clients
Participer aux évaluations et au suivi de la performance qualité des fournisseurs
Conduire ou participer aux audits fournisseurs
Collaborer avec les différentes entités du groupe Resonetics sur des problématiques et projets qualité transverses

Bonne maîtrise des exigences de la norme ISO 13485

Esprit analytique, rigueur et capacité à structurer et prioriser les activités
Autonomie, pragmatisme et forte orientation résolution de problèmes
Excellentes capacités de communication et aptitude à travailler avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et internationales

Test Automation Engineer \- Molecular Diagnostics
Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our long\-standing client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a
Test Automation Engineer \- Molecular Diagnostics
Join an innovative team shaping the future of diagnostics. As a Software Engineer in Test, you will develop and implement end\-to\-end automated test strategies for complex molecular diagnostic platforms.

Working at the intersection of hardware, software, mechanics, and biological assays, you will ensure robust system integration, software security, and reliable performance. Using advanced test automation and robotics, you will validate complex platforms and help deliver fast, precise, and reliable diagnostic results to clinical laboratories.

Quality Assurance for High\-Tech: Development and implementation of automated test strategies for a complex overall system in molecular diagnostics.
BDD Methodology: Active application of Behavior\-Driven Development to translate requirements into executable specifications.
AI\-Driven Test Development: Leverage state\-of\-the\-art AI agents and automated generation tools to design, write, and maintain scalable test cases across software, hardware, and assay workflows.
Development of Test Environments: Construction and maintenance of test frameworks using tools similar to Selenium, Appium, or SpecFlow, supplemented by specific libraries for controlling laboratory robots.
Robotics Integration: Evaluation and integration of commercial robot arms (e.g., Cobots) as well as participation in the development of internal robotics tools to simulate user interactions on the device (e.g., pipetting, loading cartridges).
ALM \& Traceability: Use of ALM tools such as Codebeamer to manage requirements and test cases and to ensure traceability.
CI/CD Integration: Responsibility for automated quality assurance within our GitHub repositories and Azure DevOps (ADO) pipelines.
End\-to\-End Verification: Ensuring data integrity from the barcode scan of the patient sample to the final analysis of the PCR result.
Compliance \& Documentation: Supporting the creation of test plans, protocols, and reports in accordance with ISO 13485 and other relevant regulatory standards for medical devices.

Education: Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Medical Technology, or a comparable qualification.
Technical Expertise: Min. 5 years experience as a Software Engineer in Test (SET) or Test Automation Engineer, ideally within complex mechatronic, medical device, or biotech systems. You have sound experience in software development and master clean coding principles.
Automation \& BDD Expert: Proficient in using modern test automation frameworks, with desired knowledge of behavior driven development methodologies.
AI Tooling Proficiency: Practical experience using AI coding assistants, LLM agents, or AI\-native test management tools to automate, refactor, and maintain testing assets.
ALM Know\-how: Experience with Application Lifecycle Management tools, ideally Codebeamer, is a major advantage.
Analytical Talent: Ability to familiarize yourself with the logic of complex diagnostic systems.
Testing Experience: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level certification

No travel required

Modern campus with green spaces and areas for interaction

Varied and interesting range of tasks

As a Senior Product Quality Engineer at Peloton, you will be responsible for ensuring our hardware products are designed, manufactured, and tested to a high quality standard so that our members can continue to access Peloton’s fitness experiences throughout the life of their products.

You will need to identify major risks starting from the earliest project stages and define quality plans to mitigate and control these risks prior to launch.

You will also be responsible for leading investigations of top issues from root cause analysis through to corrective action, and documenting learnings to prevent recurrence of similar issues in the future.

This role will work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Service and Repair, and other teams starting from concept through to mass production and sustaining.

Partner with multi-functional teams through early risk assessments (using FMEA/NUD processes and past lessons learned). Implement mitigation strategies and test plans to address and close potential risks.
Drive alignment across the various Quality functions, including Supplier Quality, Field Quality, Reliability, Failure Analysis, and Safety.
Lead cross-functional response to critical quality escalations and drive complex issues to closure using methodical 8D/RCCA approaches.
Define, implement, and audit quality processes at our FATP sites to ensure final products meet quality targets.
Develop predictive models to estimate warranty rates from available field test and reliability data.
Communicate Quality risks, mitigations, and next steps to the leadership team and other key stakeholders.
Influence partners to implement quality improvements for field performance.
This role requires domestic and international travel up to 30%.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or other technical discipline.
6+ years of experience in product development with 3+ years specifically in a Quality role for complex electro-mechanical products (e.g., Fitness Equipment, Medical Devices, Automotive, or Consumer Electronics).
Demonstrated understanding of NPI (New Product Introduction) cycles and how to successfully drive quality improvements during development.
Track record of leading cross-functional technical teams through the resolution of business-critical quality issues.
Ability to develop specifications and test plans, and translate test results into field predictions.
Proficiency in statistical data analysis and related software tools (e.g., Minitab, JMP).

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to build consensus and influence decisions at all levels of an organization.

You will lead the technical direction for quality on a large, feature-rich product, bring practical AI approaches into the workflow where they genuinely add value, and collaborate across teams to help product engineers own their tests.

An engineer’s approach to quality, preferring to build tools and automate processes rather than maintain legacy tasks.
Strong architectural judgment and a commitment to writing clean, maintainable code.
Practical curiosity about AI, with a clear point of view on where it genuinely helps and where it falls short.
A habit of working independently without formal specifications, figuring out the product, and determining what matters most.
Clear, direct communication skills and the initiative to walk up to developers and persuade teams to improve how they work.
An interest in mentoring colleagues, setting technical standards, and sharing knowledge across teams.
What you’ll need
Advanced skills in Kotlin or Java, with a solid grasp of object-oriented design and design patterns.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining test automation for complex, mission-critical backends, web services, or desktop applications.

A proven track record of creating internal platform tools or developer-experience improvements that measurably speed up engineering workflows.
Fluency in spoken and written English.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Axon’s RF sensors detect and locate drones so public safety and critical infrastructure teams can protect airspace. You will own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor capabilities — spanning regression, integration, and real-world validation — so those systems are trustworthy in the lab and in the field.

You will work closely with RF Engineering at the intersection of software, hardware, and real-world RF, helping turn technical evidence into confident product decisions.
Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel, Germany office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

Own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor software from design through release, adding rigor through regression, integration, and real-world validation.
Design and own test strategies spanning feature, regression, integration / interface, system, and field validation. Combine automated coverage with targeted manual validation based on risk and technical feasibility.
Develop in-depth functional tests for individual components of the RF sensor software, and keep those tests maintainable as the product evolves.
Reproduce, isolate, and characterize issues on real sensor hardware and in test environments; capture clear reproduction steps, logs, and environment details.
Build and maintain hardware-backed automated regression tests and supporting test tooling.
Monitor and improve development and test systems and test hardware so environments stay stable, observable, and ready for daily use.
Partner closely with RF Engineering and independently verify behavior in realistic environments and across system interfaces. Execute system, release, field, and acceptance testing with release stakeholders.
Document test results and defects clearly, and contribute to software design reviews and after-action reviews for the work you own.
Share knowledge with the wider team, give actionable feedback, and support newer engineers and interns through pairing, reviews, and onboarding.
Use approved agentic AI tools regularly to design tests, analyze results, and draft documentation and review AI output against quality, security, and performance standards before you rely on it.

A degree or vocational qualification in electrical engineering, computer science, embedded systems, or a related field
3+ years of experience testing software that runs on or with hardware (embedded products, devices, sensors, or similar systems), including independently owning the test and quality approach for that work.
Experience with RF, embedded, sensor, or similarly hardware-integrated systems, with the technical aptitude and curiosity to develop deep expertise in RF sensor technologies.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests or test tooling, ideally in Python pytest, with the ability to independently support hardware-backed regression testing.
Comfort working in Linux-based systems (SSH, Networking).
A collaborative, quality-focused working style: you Join Forces with others, Own It on the quality of the work you take on, and speak up with candor when something is unclear or broken.
It’s a plus if you have experience with drones or hardware-in-the-loop / continuous integration test setups and an interest in supporting others as they grow.

Project Overview: At Flosum , we build the leading native DevOps, Release Management, and Data Backup solutions for the Salesforce ecosystem. While our core platform is native to Salesforce, we utilize a hyperscale, open-cloud architecture on AWS for key web applications and high-throughput background processing.
We are looking for an expert Senior QA Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain an end-to-end automated testing framework that bridges our AWS cloud web applications and our core Salesforce architecture. This is a mission-critical role where you will ensure the seamless, secure sync of enterprise DevOps data between cloud microservices and Salesforce metadata.

Design and implement an automated testing framework covering both our AWS-hosted web app and our connected Salesforce native workflows.
Automate end-to-end user journeys that cross platforms (e.g., actions initiated in our cloud web UI that trigger deployments or metadata backups inside Salesforce).
Create stable UI tests for Salesforce Lightning that resist dynamic ID changes and effectively handle Shadow DOM components (using UTAM, Playwright, or enterprise testing tools).
Develop robust API automation suites to validate real-time data integrations, webhooks, and secure queues running between AWS and Salesforce.
Integrate the automated test suites cleanly into modern Git-based CI/CD pipelines.

4+ years in QA Automation Engineering, specifically handling complex enterprise integrations.
Deep Salesforce Expertise: Exceptional understanding of Salesforce Lightning architecture, metadata, security models, and developer workflows.
Technical Stack: Proficient in code-first automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) OR deep expertise in Salesforce-specific automated testing systems (Provar, ACCELQ, or UTAM framework).
API & Database Testing: Expertise in REST API testing and a strong command of SOQL queries for direct Salesforce database verification.
DevOps Mindset: Solid experience setting up automated test steps within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, or cloud developer tools).

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.
Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S.

Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

Based out of Rocket Lab’s global headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the Mechanical Test Engineer II is responsible for leading and executing test campaigns for satellite components and systems. This includes designing and implementing test setups, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring compliance with test requirements. The role involves collaboration with cross-functional teams to develop and improve test processes.

Lead the execution of qualification and acceptance test campaigns for satellite components and systems.
Design and implement test setups, including mechanical fixtures, instrumentation, and data acquisition systems.
Analyze test data and generate detailed test reports.
Collaborate with design and systems engineers to define test requirements and ensure compliance.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during testing.
Mentor and provide guidance to junior engineers and technicians.
Contribute to the development and improvement of test processes and infrastructure.

Scopely is looking for a QA Analyst to join our Monopoly Go! team in Barcelona.
At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
Monopoly GO! is our new casual game and a key franchise that has just become one of Scopely’s largest games enjoyed by millions of players. The team is based in Europe and the US, and works every day to create captivating new experiences for our players.

Reporting to your Vertical Group QA Lead of Live Minigames, you will play a vital role in upholding quality standards within one of Monopoly Go’s tightly integrated teams, known as a Pod. Collaborating with both internal and external partners, you’ll support regular feature and content releases, from initial concept through to post-release support, ensuring that the highest quality is maintained throughout.
As a key advocate for quality at Scopely, you will help shape our ongoing commitment to excellence.
Ensure your pod’s contributions to each release meet the highest standard of quality, focusing on both defect prevention and overall user experience, while also maintaining a broad, holistic view of release quality across the wider team
Develop clear and comprehensive test plans that define scope of coverage, accurate time estimates, resourcing needs, tooling / cheat needs, and any wider requirements to support testing from concept through to release
Drive the creation, upkeep, and execution of test suites and cases tailored to your pod’s specific needs and evolving scope
Support and adopt AI-driven QA initiatives, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, coverage, and reporting
Maintain a clean and prioritized bug database in alignment with your pod’s work
Lead the onboarding of external embedded QA resources into your pod, ensuring they are set up for success and aligned with internal processes, while fostering a strong working relationship to remain aligned on priorities at all times
Take ownership of your pod’s quality output by leading through example, performing hands-on testing, and ensuring accountability at all stages of development
Raise pre-production quality concerns by reviewing briefs and design documents, championing a ‘shift left’ attitude
Facilitate pod-specific playtests to gather broader feedback, track issues effectively, and ensure follow-up actions are taken where needed
Collaborate with Customer Support and the Live & Release teams to investigate live issues, advocating for timely resolutions while addressing root causes to prevent recurrence
Adhere to team-wide QA governance and best practices, ensuring full alignment with the project’s QA lifecycle from inception through post-release support
Actively participate in POD and QA team ceremonies, providing feedback and staying aligned with team strategies and direction
Collaborate closely with developers to understand changes in scope and assess cross-functional impacts that may require additional quality control
Monitor holistic app health metrics such as ANRs and crash rates, particularly following your pod’s contributions to a release, and act accordingly to mitigate issues
Embody and promote Scopely’s core tenets through your actions, communication, and leadership

Strong verbal / written communication and an excellent attention to detail
Strong time management, accountability and organisational skills
Strong negotiation skills with the ability to effectively advocate for your team’s needs, while maintaining a clear understanding of business priorities to ensure balanced, mutually beneficial outcomes
Proactive, enthusiastic and self-motivated
Flexible to an agile setup with the ability to multitask, managing coverage for multiple high profile releases with strict deadlines
A strong commercial awareness with an understanding of business priorities and goals

Job Description
Process Quality Engineer
Plays a key role in driving manufacturing excellence by ensuring high-quality performance, regulatory compliance, and continuous process improvement across factory operations. Partnering closely with production teams and suppliers, this role supports quality investigations, change management, non-conformance resolution, performance monitoring, and CAPA implementation to enhance product quality, strengthen process controls, and support operational success.

Drive the management of Non-Conformances (NCs), Quality Notifications (QNs), and CAPA activities, analyzing defects, implementing corrective actions, and ensuring effective resolution of quality issues.
Support risk assessments, PFMEA updates, design changes, manufacturing process development, and design transfer activities to maintain robust process controls and product quality.
Monitor factory quality performance and compliance, leveraging data analysis, statistical techniques, supplier quality collaboration, and continuous improvement initiatives to optimize operations.
Coordinate quality engineering and quality assurance activities, maintain manufacturing quality systems, and support successful New Product Introductions (NPI) and product transfer projects.
Partner with suppliers, R&D, and manufacturing teams to investigate complex quality issues, drive process validation and improvement initiatives, and communicate key quality metrics, trends, and compliance results to stakeholders.

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Science, or a related field; vocational education also accepted.
2+ years of experience required with a Bachelor’s degree, or a minimum of 4 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Process Engineering, Safety Engineering, or a related field with vocational education.
Strong understanding of quality engineering principles, including Process Quality Management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA methodologies, process monitoring, and regulatory requirements.
Skilled in data analysis, manufacturing processes, continuous improvement, risk assessment, technical documentation, and Design for Quality (DFQ) to support operational excellence and product quality.

That reduces manual load and speeds up how quickly we identify, understand, and resolve issues across our test and on-road fleets.
This is a highly collaborative, detail-oriented role with a direct impact on the safety and efficiency of Wayve's development pipeline.

Document and measure existing Triage and Detective workflows to identify opportunities for automation and process improvement
Prioritise improvements based on cost, benefit, impact, and feasibility
Partner with Detective Engineers to integrate their scripts and tools into scalable, productised workflows
Work with development, ML, and AI teams to deliver the tooling improvements Triage needs
Build automation pipelines — including triage bots and behavioural classifiers — that reduce manual load on Triage Specialists
Validate automation changes and outputs, including the accuracy and reliability of classifications and suggested root causes
Document newly implemented automations: what they do, how they work, how to use them, known limitations, and expected outputs
Measure and report on triage quality and throughput to track the impact of automation
Collaborate with senior management and cross-functional stakeholders to shape the roadmap for business-critical automation
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (including trips to our London office)

Essential
3+ years of experience working with complex systems, ideally within robotics or autonomous vehicles
Strong scripting and analytical skills (e.g. Python, SQL, Bash/Shell)
Hands-on experience operating in a remote Linux environment
Experience building or maintaining data pipelines or notebooks (e.g. Databricks, Jupyter)
Great communication skills, able to explain complex technical problems to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Expertise using issue tracking and configuration management tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket/GitLab
Comfort with ambiguity — able to measure an existing workflow, identify where automation adds value, and scope a sensible solution
Desirable
Experience with web development languages (e.g. HTML, CSS, React, Java) for building internal tooling
Practical experience with machine learning or classification models (e.g. PyTorch)
Experience with cloud services (ideally Microsoft Azure)
Passion for taking research ideas to production
Track record of promoting statistical rigour and experimental best practice
Experience working in a fast-moving tech company or startup

Develop automated tests to validate AI agent performance, usage, operational health, security, and reliability across supported AI platforms and integrations.
Contribute to automated logging, metrics, monitoring, and observability validation, ensuring AI agents and governance capabilities meet operational and compliance requirements.
Explore and evaluate emerging AI testing and agentic automation frameworks, interoperability standards such as MCP and Agent-to-Agent communication, and technologies that can enable autonomous or intelligent QA automation.
Continuously identify opportunities to replace manual testing with scalable, reliable, and AI-driven automation, improving release confidence, test coverage, execution speed, and overall engineering efficiency.
Document technical designs, automation frameworks, test strategies, implementation details, operational procedures, and QA engineering best practices.

Strong proficiency with Google Cloud, AWS, and other cloud infrastructure technologies, including testing and troubleshooting cloud-based distributed systems.

Document results and produce clear, comprehensive test reports
Maintain effective communication with peers, developers, and stakeholders
Assist with laboratory equipment setup, tracking, organization, and maintenance
Design, develop and maintain test automation solutions to improve test coverage and efficiency

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline

In-depth understanding of electronic control systems, microcontrollers, and hardware/software integration
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, adapting to changing priorities and timelines
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly and concisely
Hands‑on experience testing and debugging software, firmware, and hardware‑based systems
Experience developing programmatic test solutions or automation, using Python, C, and/or C++
Experience with the following operating systems: Microsoft Windows and Linux
Experience with application lifecycle management tools supporting requirements traceability, test case development, and workflow management (e.g., IBM ELM)
Understanding of Agile development methodologies, such as Scrum, in an embedded systems environment
Desired Skills
Experience working with geographically distributed teams
Exposure to or interest in the rail and transportation industry
